reproduction.source_of_truth: workflow run URL, run_id, head_sha, reviewed job/step and command fields in this report
reproduction.classification_boundary: job/step names classify likely category; root cause requires the linked GitHub log

limitations: Wall-clock is created_at to updated_at and includes queue time; it is not execution-only duration.
GitHub API sample is the latest 100 PRs, 100 test.yml runs, and 50 daily-smoke.yml runs; no historical pagination beyond those limits.
Failure categories are name-based triage hints and do not replace log-level root-cause review.
This collector does not execute selector backtests; mapping metrics belong to the canonical Phase 1 evidence.
The R9 snapshot is static evidence; fork Secret isolation and runtime permission behavior require a Phase 1 acceptance run.
The Phase 1 matrix is frozen as a contract for later work and is not evidence that Phase 1 has passed.

phase1_acceptance_matrix_review.reason: Semantic validation, selector backtests and R9 execution belong to Phase 1 and are not Phase 0 exit requirements.

mapping_coverage_backtest.reason: This collector does not execute the selector; consult canonical Phase 1 evidence.

historical_failure_log_review.status_note: Historical log review is retained separately and is not treated as fresh evidence for the current main SHA.
